_source.oracle: Orekit EcksteinHechlerPropagator, BrouwerLyddanePropagator, FixedPointConverter with EcksteinHechlerTheory and BrouwerLyddaneTheory (damping 1)
_source.frame: EME2000; both theories are frame-agnostic and take the pole as +Z
_source.units: metres, metres per second, radians, seconds; m2 in rad/s^2
_source.states: initial is the osculating Cartesian state each propagator starts from; samples are Orekit propagateOrbit at epoch + dt_s; from_mean starts a propagator from the printed mean elements (PropagationType.MEAN)
_source.eckstein_hechler_elements: circular parameters a, ex = e cos(pa), ey = e sin(pa), i, raan, alpha_m = pa + mean anomaly
_source.brouwer_lyddane_elements: Keplerian a, e, i, pa, raan, m (mean anomaly)
